## Impact and considerations

<!--
Keep only the applicable points:
- UI: accessibility, keyboard/focus behavior, localization, and relevant states
- Dependencies: upstream release notes, compatibility, and reason for updating
- Compatibility: breaking changes, migrations, deployment, rollback, or flags
- Documentation: user, developer, API, or operational documentation changes
-->

## Reviewer guidance

<!--
Call out areas that deserve extra attention, known limitations, intentionally

-->

## Readiness checklist

<!--
Items may remain unchecked while work is in progress. Complete or explain each
applicable item before requesting review.
-->

- [ ] The title follows `<type>(<optional-scope>): <subject>`.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated modifications.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and removed debug or accidental changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests, or explained why automated testing is impractical.
- [ ] I recorded the test results and reviewed the coverage impact.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, or explained why it is not needed.
- [ ] I included the required screenshots or video for UI changes, or marked them N/A with a reason.
- [ ] CI passes, or any failures are clearly explained.
